text: The application for type approval shall be submitted by the holder of the trade name or mark or by his duly accredited representative.
The application for approval shall be accompanied by the prescribed documents in triplicate and sample(s).
The application shall be accompanied by drawings sufficiently detailed to permit identification of the type and, if applicable, of the class of the lamp.
The drawings shall show geometrically in what position(s) the lamp(s) and/or the lighting units may be mounted on the vehicle in relation to ground and vehicle longitudinal median plane.

The drawings shall show the axis of observation to be taken as the axis of reference in the tests (horizontal angle H = 0°, vertical angle V = 0°), or in the case of lighting units each of them in vertical (axial) section and in front elevation with main details of the optical design including the axis/axes of reference, and the point to be taken as the centre of reference during the tests.
The drawings shall show the limit of the apparent surface of the function(s).
The drawings shall show the space reserved and the arrangement intended for the approval marking or the Unique Identifier.
The drawings shall show the replaceable light source module(s) and the space reserved for the specific identification code(s) of the module(s) on the lamp and on the module(s).
condition: in case of replaceable light source module(s)

text: The drawings shall show a frontal view, with details of lens ribbing if any, and the cross section and any optical features of the lens, if applicable.
condition: if applicable

text: The application shall be accompanied by a brief technical description stating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
condition: in the case of lamps with replaceable UN approved light sources

text: The brief technical description shall state the light source module specific identification code.
condition: in the case of lamps with replaceable light source modules

text: The brief technical description shall state the make and type of electronic light source control gear(s).
condition: if any electronic light source control gear is used and it is not part of an installation unit

text: The brief technical description shall state the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed according to UN Regulation No. 128.
condition: in the case the lamp shall also be approved with LED substitute light source(s)

text: The brief technical description shall state the mounting position(s) of the lamp in relation to the ground and the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
condition: if the device is equipped with an adjustable reflector

text: The brief technical description shall state the measures provided to ensure compliance with the provisions of paragraph 4.13.1. (failure signal).
condition: where applicable

text: For a headlamp, the technical description shall specify whether the headlamp is intended to provide both a passing-beam and a driving-beam or only one of these beams.

For a headlamp intended to provide a passing-beam, the technical description shall specify whether it is designed for both left-hand and right-hand traffic or for either left-hand or right-hand traffic only.
condition: if the headlamp is intended to provide a passing-beam

text: For a headlamp, the technical description shall specify to which Class(es) (passing-beam and/or driving-beam) the headlamp belongs.
For a headlamp with light source module(s), the technical description shall include a brief technical specification of the light source module(s).
condition: in the case of light source module(s)

text: For a headlamp with light source module(s), the technical description shall include a drawing with dimensions, the basic electrical and photometric values and the objective luminous flux, and for each light source module a statement whether it is replaceable or not.
condition: in the case of light source module(s)

text: For a headlamp with light source module(s) and electronic light source control gear, the technical description shall include information on the electrical interface necessary for approval testing.
condition: in case of electronic light source control gear

text: For a headlamp, the technical description shall specify whether the left and the right headlamps are operating as matched pair.
For an AFS, the technical description shall specify the lighting function(s) and their modes to be provided by the system, indicated in a form conforming to the model of Annex 1.

For an AFS, the technical description shall specify the lighting units contributing to each function and the signals with the technical characteristics relevant to their operation, indicated in a form conforming to the model of Annex 14.
For an AFS, the technical description shall specify which categories of the bending mode requirements apply, if any.
For an AFS, the technical description shall specify which additional data set(s) of Class E passing-beam provisions according to Table 12 apply, if any.
For an AFS, the technical description shall specify which set(s) of Class W passing-beam provisions according to paragraph 5.3.2. apply, if any.
For an AFS, the technical description shall specify which lighting units provide or contribute to one or more passing-beam cut-off(s), indicated in a form conforming to the model of Annex 14.

For an AFS, the technical description shall specify the indication(s) according to paragraph 5.3.5.1. with respect to paragraph 6.22. of UN Regulation No. 48 or paragraph 6.18. of UN Regulation No. 53.
For an AFS, the technical description shall specify which lighting units are designed to provide the minimum passing-beam illumination according to paragraph 5.3.2.8.1.
For an AFS, the technical description shall specify mounting and operation requirements for test purposes.
For an AFS, the technical description shall specify any other relevant information.

For an AFS with light source module(s), the technical description shall include for each module a brief technical specification, a drawing with dimensions, basic electrical and photometric values and objective luminous flux with a statement whether it is replaceable or not, and, in case of electronic light source control gear, information on the electrical interface necessary for approval testing.
condition: in the case of light source module(s)

text: For an AFS, the technical description shall specify any other front-lighting or front light signalling function(s) provided by lamp(s) grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with the lighting units of the system for which approval is sought, with sufficient information for identification of the respective lamp(s) and indication of the Regulation(s) according to which they are intended to be (separately) approved.
condition: if other functions are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated

text: In the case of adaptation of the driving-beam, the technical description shall specify which lighting units provide or contribute to the gradual adaptation of the driving-beam and the sensor system along with the technical characteristics relevant to their operation, indicated in a form conforming to the model of Annex 14.
condition: in the case of adaptation of the driving-beam

text: The documentation shall contain a safety concept which, to the satisfaction of the Technical Service, describes the measures designed into the system to ensure compliance with paragraphs 4.11.2. and 5.3.2.5.4.

The safety concept shall indicate the instructions for verification of the measures according to paragraph 5.3.2.6. and/or give access to relevant documents (e.g. FMEA, FTA or similar process) demonstrating the system's sufficient reliability and safe operation of the measures.

In the case of Driver Assistance Projection according to UN Regulation No. 48, the application shall specify the size (horizontal and vertical angular limits) of the zone used for performing said projections.
condition: in the case of Driver Assistance Projection

text: If not otherwise specified, the application shall be accompanied by two complete samples, one intended for installation on the left side and one for the right side of the vehicle.
condition: if not otherwise specified

text: For all lamps with plastic outer lenses, except cornering lamps, the application shall be accompanied by samples of the plastic material of which the lenses are made (see Annex 8).
condition: lamps with plastic outer lenses, except cornering lamps

text: In the case of an AFS, the application shall be accompanied by one set of samples of the system including the mounting devices, supply and operating devices, and signal generators if any.

For a type of lamp differing only by the trade name or mark from an approved type, the application shall be accompanied by a declaration by the lamp manufacturer that the type submitted is identical (except in the trade name or mark) with and produced by the same manufacturer as the type already approved, identified by its approval number.
condition: type differing only by trade name or mark from an approved type

text: For a type of lamp differing only by the trade name or mark from an approved type, the application shall be accompanied by two samples bearing the new trade name or mark or equivalent documentation.
condition: type differing only by trade name or mark from an approved type

text: For cornering lamps equipped with non-replaceable filament light source(s) or light source module(s) equipped with non-replaceable filament light source(s), the applicant shall annex to the type approval documentation a report according to paragraph 4.5.2.5.
condition: cornering lamps with non-replaceable filament light source(s)

text: A separate approval is required for each lamp listed in paragraph 1.

When two or more lamps are part of the same assembly of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval is granted only if each of these lamps satisfies the requirements of this Regulation or of another Regulation.
condition: grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps

text: Lamps not satisfying any one of the applicable Regulations shall not be part of an assembly of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
condition: grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps

text: If the devices submitted for approval in pursuance of paragraph 3.1. meet the requirements of this Regulation, approval shall be granted.
An approval number shall be assigned to each type approved.
The approval number shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.

The same Contracting Party shall not assign the same approval number to another type of device covered by this Regulation, except in the case of an extension of the approval to a front fog lamp differing only in the colour of the light emitted.

Notice of approval or of extension or refusal or withdrawal of approval of a device type shall be communicated to the Contracting Parties to the 1958 Agreement applying this Regulation by means of a form conforming to the model in Annex 1.

The applicant shall submit sufficient documentation to prove the capability of the system to comply with paragraph 6.22. of UN Regulation No. 48 or paragraphs 6.16. and 6.18. of UN Regulation No. 53 when correctly installed.
condition: if approval is sought for an AFS not intended to be included in a vehicle type approval under UN R48, or for an ADB or AFS for L3 vehicles not intended to be included in a vehicle type approval under UN R53

text: The system shall be approved according to UN Regulation No. 10.
condition: if approval is sought for an AFS not intended to be included in a vehicle type approval under UN R48, or for an ADB or AFS for L3 vehicles not intended to be included in a vehicle type approval under UN R53

text: A driving-beam headlamp of Class A shall be identified by the symbol "R", or "YR" if the device is part of a matched pair.
condition: Class A driving-beam

text: A passing-beam headlamp of Class V (asymmetrical) shall be identified by the symbol "V", or "YV" if the device is part of a matched pair.
condition: Class V passing-beam

text: A driving-beam headlamp of Class B shall be identified by the symbol "HR", or "YHR" if the device is part of a matched pair.
condition: Class B driving-beam

text: A passing-beam headlamp of Class C (asymmetrical) shall be identified by the symbol "C", or "YC" if the device is part of a matched pair.
condition: Class C passing-beam

text: An auxiliary driving-beam of Class RA shall be identified by the symbol "RA".
condition: Class RA driving-beam

text: An AFS Class AFS-C basic passing-beam shall be identified by the symbol "XC".
condition: Class AFS-C

text: An AFS Class AFS-E motorway passing-beam shall be identified by the symbol "XCE".
condition: Class AFS-E

text: An AFS Class AFS-V town passing-beam shall be identified by the symbol "XCV".
condition: Class AFS-V

text: An AFS Class AFS-W adverse weather passing-beam shall be identified by the symbol "XCW".
condition: Class AFS-W

text: An AFS for vehicles of category L3 Class AFS-C basic passing-beam shall be identified by the symbol "MXC".
condition: Class AFS-C for L3

text: An AFS for vehicles of category L3 Class AFS-E motorway passing-beam shall be identified by the symbol "MXCE".
condition: Class AFS-E for L3

text: An AFS for vehicles of category L3 Class AFS-V town passing-beam shall be identified by the symbol "MXCV".
condition: Class AFS-V for L3

text: An AFS for vehicles of category L3 Class AFS-W adverse weather passing-beam shall be identified by the symbol "MXCW".
condition: Class AFS-W for L3

text: An AFS Class AFS-R driving-beam shall be identified by the symbol "XR".
condition: Class AFS-R

text: In the case of a single AFS installation unit the symbol "XC" or "MXC" is marked only once.
condition: single installation unit

text: In the case of more AFS installation units each providing one or more AFS function(s), each unit is marked with the symbol "X" or "MX" followed by the identification symbol(s) of the specific AFS function(s) provided.
condition: more than one installation unit

text: A passing-beam headlamp of Class AS (symmetrical) shall be identified by the symbol "C-AS", or "YC-AS" if part of a matched pair.
condition: Class AS

text: A passing-beam headlamp of Class BS (symmetrical) shall be identified by the symbol "C-BS", or "YC-BS" if part of a matched pair.
condition: Class BS

text: A passing-beam headlamp of Class CS (symmetrical) shall be identified by the symbol "WC-CS", or "YC-CS" if part of a matched pair.
condition: Class CS

text: A passing-beam headlamp of Class DS (symmetrical) shall be identified by the symbol "WC-DS", or "YC-DS" if part of a matched pair.
condition: Class DS

text: A driving-beam headlamp of Class BS shall be identified by the symbol "R-BS", or "YR-BS" if part of a matched pair.
condition: Class BS driving-beam

text: A secondary driving-beam headlamp of Class CS shall be identified by the symbol "WR-CS", or "YR-CS" if part of a matched pair.
condition: Class CS secondary driving-beam

text: A secondary driving-beam headlamp of Class DS shall be identified by the symbol "WR-DS", or "YR-DS" if part of a matched pair.
condition: Class DS secondary driving-beam

text: An adaptive driving-beam for vehicles of category L3 shall be identified by the symbol "ADB", or "YADB" if part of a matched pair.
A front fog lamp of Class F3 shall be identified by the symbol "F3", or "YF3" if part of a matched pair.
A cornering lamp of Class K shall be identified by the symbol "K".
The change index for driving-beam headlamps of Class A shall be 0 for the 00 series and 1 for the 01 series of amendments.
condition: Class A

text: Passing-beam headlamps of Class A and Class B (asymmetrical) have change index 0 under the 00 series and are not available for type approval under the 01 series of amendments.
condition: Class A or B passing-beam

text: Passing-beam headlamps of Class V and Class C (asymmetrical) are not available under the 00 series and have change index 0 under the 01 series of amendments.
condition: Class V or C passing-beam

text: The change index for driving-beam headlamps of Class B shall be 0 for the 00 series and 1 for the 01 series of amendments.
condition: Class B

text: The auxiliary driving-beam of Class RA is not available under the 00 series and has change index 0 under the 01 series of amendments.
condition: Class RA

text: The change index for adaptive driving-beam shall be 0 for the 00 series and 1 for the 01 series of amendments.
Adaptive driving-beam (ADB) for vehicles of category L3 is not available under the 00 series and has change index 0 under the 01 series of amendments.
Driving-beam and passing-beam headlamps of Class D (GDL) have change index 0 under the 00 series and are not available under the 01 series of amendments.
condition: Class D (GDL)

text: The change index for AFS Classes AFS-C, AFS-E, AFS-V, AFS-W and AFS-R shall be 0 for the 00 series and 1 for the 01 series of amendments.
The change index for passing-beam headlamps of Classes AS, BS, CS and DS (symmetrical) shall be 0 for the 00 series and 1 for the 01 series of amendments.
Passing-beam and driving-beam headlamps of Class ES have change index 0 under the 00 series and are not available under the 01 series of amendments.
condition: Class ES

text: The change index for driving-beam headlamps of Class BS and secondary driving-beam headlamps of Classes CS and DS shall be 0 for the 00 series and 1 for the 01 series of amendments.
The change index for front fog lamps of Class F3 shall be 0 for the 00 series and 1 for the 01 series of amendments.
The change index for cornering lamps of Class K shall be 0 for the 00 series and 1 for the 01 series of amendments.

Every road illumination device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4., or for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.
All markings on the road illumination device shall be clearly legible and indelible.
The value for "a" of the approval marking in part 1 of Annex 13 shall be at least 5 mm on plastic material.
condition: marking on plastic material

text: The value for "a" of the approval marking in part 1 of Annex 13 shall be at least 8 mm on glass.
condition: marking on glass

text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
The approval marking shall include the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.2.
The approval marking shall include the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
The approval marking shall include the symbol(s) identifying the road illumination function(s) according to Table 1 and, if applicable, the additional symbols of paragraphs 3.3.2.4.1. to 3.3.2.4.9.

Headlamps/AFS installation units meeting left-hand traffic requirements only shall bear in the approval marking a horizontal arrow pointing to the right of an observer facing the headlamp, i.e. to the side of the road on which the traffic moves.
condition: meeting left-hand traffic requirements only

text: Headlamps/AFS installation units designed to meet the requirements of both traffic systems, with or without an appropriate adjustment of the setting of the optical unit or the light source(s) or light source module(s), shall bear in the approval marking a horizontal arrow with a head on each end, the heads pointing respectively to the left and to the right.
condition: designed to meet requirements of both traffic systems

text: Front fog lamps of Class F3 having asymmetric light distribution and which must not be indiscriminately mounted on either side of the vehicle shall bear an arrow pointing to the outside of the vehicle.
condition: asymmetric light distribution and not to be indiscriminately mounted on either side

text: Road illumination devices incorporating an outer lens of plastic material shall bear the group of letters "PL" affixed near the symbols identifying the function(s).
condition: outer lens of plastic material

text: Headlamps/AFS installation units meeting the requirements of the driving-beam shall bear, placed near the circle surrounding the letter "E", an indication of the maximum luminous intensity expressed by a reference mark (I'M) as defined in paragraph 5.1.4.2.
condition: meeting driving-beam requirements

text: In the case of grouped or reciprocally incorporated driving-beam headlamps/AFS lighting units, the indication of the maximum luminous intensity of the driving-beams as a whole shall be expressed by the reference mark (I'M) placed near the circle surrounding the letter "E".
condition: grouped or reciprocally incorporated driving-beam headlamps/AFS lighting units

text: In the case of AFS, a score shall be placed above the letter(s) of the symbol when the AFS function(s) is(are) provided by more than one installation unit on that side of the system.
condition: AFS function provided by more than one installation unit on that side

text: In the case of AFS, the symbol "T" shall be marked after the symbol(s) of all lighting function(s) and/or class(es) designed to comply with the respective bend lighting provisions, with said symbol(s) arranged together and leftmost to the symbol "T".
condition: functions designed to comply with bend lighting provisions

text: On headlamps meeting the requirements in respect of the passing beam of Class C and the driving beam of Class B, "HCR" may be marked as the symbols for passing beam and driving beam.
condition: Class C passing beam and Class B driving beam

text: On headlamps meeting the requirements in respect of both the passing beam and the driving beam of the same Class BS, CS or DS, the letters "CR-BS" for Class BS, "WCR-CS" for Class CS or "WCR-DS" for Class DS headlamps shall be marked.
condition: passing and driving beam of same Class BS, CS or DS

text: The approval number, the symbols and the additional symbols shall be placed close to the circle and either above or below the letter "E", or to the right or left of that letter.
The digits of the approval number shall be on the same side of the letter "E" and face the same direction.
Unless otherwise specified, each symbol shall be marked individually in accordance with Table 1.
condition: unless otherwise specified

text: The approval marking may be replaced by the Unique Identifier, if available; the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format of Figure I.
condition: if the Unique Identifier is available and used

text: Road illumination functions or systems shall bear the approval marking or the Unique Identifier.
Road illumination functions or systems shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.

Devices including a passing-beam designed to satisfy the requirements of both right-hand and left-hand traffic shall bear markings indicating the two settings of the optical unit on the vehicle or of the light source on the reflector, consisting of the letters "R/D" for the right-hand traffic position and "L/G" for the left-hand traffic position.
condition: passing-beam designed for both right-hand and left-hand traffic

text: Lamps with replaceable UN approved light source(s) shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
condition: lamps with replaceable UN approved light source(s)

text: Lamps approved for LED substitute light source(s) shall also bear a marking indicating the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
condition: lamps approved for LED substitute light source(s)

text: Lamps with replaceable light source modules shall bear a marking indicating the specific identification code(s) of the light source module(s).
condition: lamps with replaceable light source modules

text: Lamps with replaceable UN approved light source(s) or replaceable light source modules shall bear a marking indicating the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
condition: lamps with replaceable light sources or replaceable light source modules

text: Lamps with non-replaceable light source modules shall bear a marking indicating the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
condition: lamps with non-replaceable light source modules

text: Replaceable light source module(s) shall bear a marking indicating the trade name or mark of the applicant.
condition: lamps with replaceable light source module(s)

text: Replaceable light source module(s) shall bear a specific identification code comprising the starting letters "MD" followed by the approval mark without the circle (paragraph 3.3.2.1.) and the sequential number (paragraph 3.3.2.2.) and, where several non-identical light source modules are used, followed by additional symbols or characters.
condition: lamps with replaceable light source module(s)

text: The light source module identification code shall be shown in the drawings mentioned in paragraph 3.1.2.1.
condition: lamps with light source module(s)

text: The approval mark on the light source module and the one on the lamp in which the module is used shall be from the same applicant.
condition: lamps with light source module(s)

text: Replaceable light source module(s) shall bear a marking indicating the rated voltage or the range of voltage.
condition: lamps with replaceable light source module(s)

text: An electronic light source control gear which is part of the lamp but not included into the lamp body, used to operate a light source or light source module(s), shall be marked with its specific identification code and the rated input voltage or range of voltage.
condition: electronic control gear part of the lamp but not in the lamp body

text: AFS, front fog lamps and headlamps except Class AS, BS, CS and DS meeting the requirements of Annex 7 only when supplied with a voltage of 12V shall bear a marking consisting of the Number 24 crossed out by an oblique cross (X) near the holders of the light source(s) as shown in Annex 12.
condition: meeting Annex 7 only at 12V; not Class AS, BS, CS, DS headlamps

text: Headlamps producing the principal passing-beam and having additional lighting unit(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the additional lighting unit(s).
condition: headlamp having additional lighting unit(s)

text: Additional lighting unit(s) of a headlamp shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
condition: headlamp having additional lighting unit(s)

text: Additional lighting unit(s) with light source(s) shall bear the category(ies) of the light source(s), and where approved for LED substitute light source(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
condition: additional lighting unit with light source(s)

text: Additional lighting unit(s) with light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage and rated wattage and the specific identification code(s) of the light source module(s).
condition: additional lighting unit with light source module(s)

text: Additional lighting unit(s) shall bear their specific identification code(s), clearly legible and indelible, comprised of the starting letters "ALU" followed by the approval marking without the circle and, where several non-identical additional lighting units are used, additional symbols or characters.
condition: headlamp having additional lighting unit(s)

text: The specific identification code of the additional lighting unit(s) shall be shown in the drawings.
condition: headlamp having additional lighting unit(s)

text: The approval marking of the additional lighting unit and that of the lamp in which it is used shall be from the same applicant.
condition: headlamp having additional lighting unit(s)

text: Road illumination devices may bear on their light-emitting surface a centre of reference, which shall be as shown in Annex 11.
condition: if a centre of reference mark is used

text: The Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp.

The Unique Identifier or the approval marking, as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood, boot lid or a door is opened.
If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.
condition: outer lens designed to be separated from the main body

text: Where an outer lens is used for several devices and bears different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
condition: outer lens common to several devices with different approval markings

text: For grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, a single Unique Identifier or approval mark may be applied only provided that all the lamps satisfy the pertinent Regulation and the requirements of paragraph 3.3.2. are applied.
condition: grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps with a single mark

text: For grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps with a single approval mark, no part of the lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
condition: grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps with a single mark

text: For grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps with a single approval mark, the symbols for each lamp, appropriate to each UN Regulation under which approval has been granted, shall be marked either on the appropriate light-emitting surface or in a group such that each lamp may be clearly identified.
condition: grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps with a single mark

text: Every modification of a type of lamp shall be notified to the Type Approval Authority which approved the type, which may either consider the lamp still compliant or require a further test report from the technical service.
condition: modification of an approved lamp type

text: Confirmation or refusal of approval, specifying the alterations, shall be communicated by the procedure of paragraph 3.2.3. to the Contracting Parties applying this Regulation.

The Type Approval Authority issuing an extension of approval shall assign a series number for the extension and inform the other Contracting Parties by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 1.
condition: extension of approval

text: The conformity of production procedures shall comply with those set out in the 1958 Agreement, Schedule 1 (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3), with the requirements set forth in paragraph 6.
The approval granted in respect of a device may be withdrawn if the foregoing requirements are not met.
condition: requirements not met

text: A Contracting Party withdrawing an approval it has previously granted shall forthwith notify the other Contracting Parties applying this Regulation by means of a communication form conforming to Annex 1.
condition: approval withdrawn

text: If the holder of the approval completely ceases to manufacture an approved device, he shall inform the authority which granted the approval, which shall inform the other Contracting Parties by means of a communication form conforming to Annex 1.
condition: production definitively discontinued

text: Contracting Parties applying the Regulation shall communicate to the United Nations Secretariat the names and addresses of the Technical Services responsible for approval tests and of the Type Approval Authorities.
Lamps submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4 and 5.

The requirements of sections 5 and 6 (and referenced Annexes) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, in the series of amendments in force at the time of application, pertinent to each lamp and to the vehicle category(ies) on which it is intended to be installed, shall be applied where their verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
condition: where verification at lamp type approval is feasible

text: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
Lamps shall be so made that they give adequate illumination without dazzle when emitting the passing-beam.
Lamps shall be so made that they give good illumination when emitting the driving-beam.

Lamps shall be fitted with a device enabling them to be so adjusted on the vehicles as to comply with the rules applicable to them; such a device need not be fitted on units in which the reflector and diffusing lens cannot be separated, provided their use is confined to vehicles on which the lamp setting can be adjusted by other means.
condition: except cornering lamps

text: For headlamps of classes AS, BS, CS, DS and front fog lamps, the adjusting device may omit horizontal adjustment only provided that the headlamps are so designed that they can maintain a proper horizontal aiming even after the vertical aiming adjustment.
condition: adjusting device without horizontal adjustment

text: Where a lamp producing a principal passing-beam and a lamp producing a driving-beam, each with its own light source(s) or light source module(s), are assembled to form one unit, the adjusting device shall enable the principal passing-beam and the driving-beam to be adjusted individually.
condition: assembled unit with separate light sources; not for assemblies whose optical units are indivisible

text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128 (provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval), and/or light source module(s), and/or non-replaceable light source(s).

The applicant for type approval of the lamp shall declare that the lamp is only intended for installation on vehicles in use originally equipped with such lamps; this shall be noted in the communication form.
condition: if a light source category or categories or type(s) is restricted for use in lamps on vehicles in use and originally equipped with such lamps

text: The design of the lamp shall be such that the replaceable UN approved light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
condition: in case of replaceable UN approved light source(s)

text: The light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061; the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed applies.
condition: in case of replaceable UN approved light source(s)

text: Where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the light source holder shall conform to the IEC 60061 holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s).
condition: where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed

text: Road illumination devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
The design of a replaceable light source module shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
condition: in case of replaceable light source module(s)

text: The design of a replaceable light source module shall be such that it is tamperproof.
condition: in case of replaceable light source module(s)

text: Regardless of the use of tool(s), a replaceable light source module shall not be mechanically interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source.
condition: in case of replaceable light source module(s)

text: Regardless of the use of tool(s), a replaceable light source module shall not be mechanically interchangeable with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
condition: in case of replaceable light source module(s)

text: When the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the lamp or AFS system shall be met.
condition: in case of replaceable light source module(s)

text: Light source modules shall comply with the requirements specified in Annex 9.
condition: if applicable

text: The applicant shall annex to the type approval documentation a report, acceptable to the Authority responsible for type approval, demonstrating compliance of the non-replaceable filament light source(s) with paragraph 4.11 of IEC 60809, Edition 4.
condition: lamps equipped with non-replaceable filament light source(s) or light source module(s) equipped with non-replaceable filament light source(s)

text: The luminous flux of the light source(s), or the luminous flux of the principal passing-beam, shall be determined according to the provisions in paragraph 4.6.

The total objective luminous flux of all light sources producing the principal passing-beam of classes V, C, AFS-C or DS shall be equal or greater than 1.00∙10^3 lm, or alternatively the principal passing-beam shall meet the Table 3b zone flux requirements.
condition: principal passing-beam of class V, C, AFS-C or DS; option (a)

text: The total objective luminous flux of all light sources producing the principal passing-beam of class AS shall be equal or greater than 1.50∙10^2 lm, or alternatively the principal passing-beam shall meet the Table 3b zone flux requirements.
condition: principal passing-beam of class AS; option (a)

text: The total objective luminous flux of all light sources producing the principal passing-beam of class BS shall be equal or greater than 3.50∙10^2 lm, or alternatively the principal passing-beam shall meet the Table 3b zone flux requirements.
condition: principal passing-beam of class BS; option (a)

text: The total objective luminous flux of all light sources producing the principal passing-beam of class CS shall be equal or greater than 5.00∙10^2 lm, or alternatively the principal passing-beam shall meet the Table 3b zone flux requirements.
condition: principal passing-beam of class CS; option (a)

text: For classes V, C, AFS-C and DS, the luminous flux in the principal passing-beam, aimed according to Annex 5, shall be at least 4.00∙10^2 lm in Zone I (30°L to 30°R and 15°D to 1°U) and at least 2.00∙10^2 lm in Zone II (30°L to 30°R and 3.5°D to 1°U).
condition: if option (b) is used instead of the Table 3a light source flux minimum; classes V, C, AFS-C aimed per Annex 5 para 3.2, DS per para 3.3

text: For class AS, the luminous flux in the principal passing-beam, aimed according to Annex 5 paragraph 3.3, shall be at least 6.0∙10^1 lm in Zone I (30°L to 30°R and 15°D to 1°U) and at least 3.0∙10^1 lm in Zone II (30°L to 30°R and 3.5°D to 1°U).
condition: if option (b) is used instead of the Table 3a light source flux minimum

text: For class BS, the luminous flux in the principal passing-beam, aimed according to Annex 5 paragraph 3.3, shall be at least 1.40∙10^2 lm in Zone I (30°L to 30°R and 15°D to 1°U) and at least 7.0∙10^1 lm in Zone II (30°L to 30°R and 3.5°D to 1°U).
condition: if option (b) is used instead of the Table 3a light source flux minimum

text: For class CS, the luminous flux in the principal passing-beam, aimed according to Annex 5 paragraph 3.3, shall be at least 2.00∙10^2 lm in Zone I (30°L to 30°R and 15°D to 1°U) and at least 1.00∙10^2 lm in Zone II (30°L to 30°R and 3.5°D to 1°U).
condition: if option (b) is used instead of the Table 3a light source flux minimum

text: The total objective luminous flux of all light sources producing the principal passing-beam of class AS shall be equal or smaller than 9.00∙10^2 lm.
condition: principal passing-beam of class AS

text: The total objective luminous flux of all light sources producing the principal passing-beam of class BS shall be equal or smaller than 1.00∙10^3 lm.
condition: principal passing-beam of class BS

text: The total objective luminous flux of all light sources producing the principal passing-beam of class CS shall be equal or smaller than 2.00∙10^3 lm.
condition: principal passing-beam of class CS

text: Front fog lamps designed to operate permanently with an additional system to control the intensity of the light emitted, including those reciprocally incorporated with another function using a common light source, are permitted.
condition: if designed to operate permanently with an additional intensity control system

text: A reference shall be made in the communication form in Annex 1 when a lamp (except AFS and cornering lamps) incorporating light source(s) or light source module(s) producing the principal passing-beam or the front fog beam has a total objective luminous flux exceeding 2.00∙10^3 lumens.
condition: total objective luminous flux exceeds 2.00∙10^3 lumens; not for AFS and cornering lamps

text: A reference shall be made in the communication form in Annex 1 when an AFS incorporating light sources and/or light source modules producing the basic passing-beam has a total objective luminous flux of the lighting units indicated under item 9.2.3.(a) exceeding 2.00·10^3 lumen per side.
condition: total objective flux exceeds 2.00·10^3 lumen per side; not necessary if the AFS is intended for a vehicle of category L3

text: All photometric and colorimetric measurements shall be made under the conditions of paragraph 4.6, using the methods of measurement given in Annex 4.
In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
condition: in the case of replaceable UN approved light sources

text: The standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value when test voltage is applied.
condition: replaceable UN approved light source(s) controlled by an electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control

text: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
condition: lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s)

text: Where photometric measurements of a lamp (function) using light sources subject to more than one condition of paragraph 4.6 are made separately per applicable condition, all separate measurement results shall be added together.
condition: lamp (function) using light sources subject to more than one condition of paragraph 4.6

text: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
The photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
condition: where a front fog lamp or cornering lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions

text: All photometric and colorimetric measurements shall be repeated using the LED substitute light source(s) prescribed.
condition: where the lamp shall also be approved with LED substitute light source(s)

text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.3 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.2 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28.0 V (24 Volt-Systems).
condition: unless otherwise specified

text: A lamp and/or light source module controlled by an electronic light source control gear shall be operated for testing as specified by the applicant.
condition: lamp and/or light source module controlled by an electronic light source control gear

text: In case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) not controlled by an electronic light source control gear, the voltage supplied at the input terminals of the lamp shall be as specified by the applicant.
condition: lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear, with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s)

text: Replaceable UN approved light sources in a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities.
condition: lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear

text: Lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent from the average luminous flux, with measured luminous intensities corrected proportionally for the difference between the average and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux; alternatively, they can be tested using one light source in each holder position operating at the reference/objective luminous flux and summing the measured intensities for each direction.
condition: lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources

text: The identification of an electronic light source control gear, if applicable, and/or the voltage applied, including the tolerances, shall be noted in the communication form in Annex 1.
Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities and colorimetric characteristics shall be carried out according to Annex 10.
For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to paragraphs 4.6.1 and 4.6.2.
condition: lamps (functions) using different light source technologies

text: If the outer lens of the lamp is made of plastic material, tests shall be done according to the requirements in Annex 8.
condition: outer lens made of plastic material; except cornering lamps and headlamps of class AS

text: The UV resistance of light transmitting components located inside a front fog lamp and made of plastic material shall be tested according to Annex 8, paragraph 3.3.
condition: not necessary if low-UV type light sources (per relevant UN Regulation or Annex 9) are used or if components are shielded from UV radiation, e.g. by glass filters

text: The sharpness and linearity of the cut-off shall be tested according to the requirements in Annex 6.
condition: if applicable

text: Complementary tests shall be done according to the requirements in Annex 7 to ensure that in use there is no excessive change in photometric performance.
condition: except cornering lamps

text: Passing-beam headlamps and AFS with asymmetrical cut-off line designed for both right-hand and left-hand traffic shall allow only two different and clearly distinct settings, one for right-hand and one for left-hand traffic.
condition: designed to satisfy the requirements of both right-hand and left-hand traffic

text: The design shall preclude inadvertent shifting from one traffic setting to the other or setting in an intermediate position; conformity shall be verified by visual inspection and, where necessary, by a test fitting.
condition: designed to satisfy the requirements of both right-hand and left-hand traffic

text: Any mechanical, electromechanical or other device incorporated in headlamps or AFS for switching between driving-beam and passing-beam or for bend lighting shall be robust enough to withstand 50,000 operations under normal conditions of use.
condition: headlamps or AFS designed to provide alternately a driving-beam and a passing-beam, or a beam designed to become bend lighting

text: For headlamps of classes C and V, in the case of failure of the mechanical or electromechanical device, the luminous intensity above the line H-H shall not exceed the values of a passing-beam according to paragraph 5.2.
condition: headlamps of classes C and V; in the case of failure

text: On headlamps of classes C and V designed to provide a passing and/or a driving-beam to become bend lighting, in the case of failure a minimum luminous intensity of at least 2.50∙10^3 cd shall be fulfilled at test point 25V (V-V line, 1.72°D).
condition: headlamps of classes C and V designed to provide bend lighting; in the case of failure

text: On headlamps of classes C and V, either the principal passing-beam or the driving-beam shall always be obtained without any possibility of the mechanism stopping in between two positions.
condition: headlamps of classes C and V

text: For headlamps of classes AS, BS, CS and DS, in the case of failure it must be possible to obtain automatically a passing-beam or a state yielding values not exceeding 1.20∙10^3 cd in Zone 1 and at least 2.40∙10^3 cd at 0.86D-V, by such means as switching off, dimming, aiming downwards and/or functional substitution.
condition: headlamps of classes AS, BS, CS and DS; in the case of failure; except additional light source(s)/lighting unit(s) used to produce bend lighting

text: For headlamps of classes AS, BS, CS and DS, either the passing-beam or the driving-beam shall always be obtained without any possibility of the mechanism stopping in between the two positions.
condition: headlamps of classes AS, BS, CS and DS; except additional light source(s)/lighting unit(s) used to produce bend lighting

text: For AFS, either the passing-beam or the driving-beam shall always be obtained without any possibility of remaining in an intermediate or undefined state; if this is not possible, such a state must be covered by the provisions of paragraph 4.11.4.2.
condition: except in the case of adaptation of the driving-beam

text: For AFS, in the case of failure it must be possible to obtain automatically a passing-beam or a state yielding values not exceeding 1.30∙10^3 cd in zone III b and at least 3.40∙10^3 cd in a point of Zone Imax, by such means as switching off, dimming, aiming downwards and/or functional substitution.
condition: in the case of failure

text: When performing the failure tests on AFS, the Technical Service shall refer to the instructions supplied by the applicant.
The mechanical or electromechanical device shall be constructed so that the user cannot, with ordinary tools, change the shape or position of the moving parts, or influence the switching device.
condition: headlamps or AFS designed to provide alternately a driving-beam and a passing-beam, or a beam designed to become bend lighting

text: Lamps with asymmetrical cut-off line designed for traffic on one side of the road only shall have appropriate measures (e.g. occulting part of the outer lens, downward movement of the beam, or any other measure removing or reducing the asymmetrical part of the beam) to prevent discomfort to road-users in a country where traffic moves on the opposite side.
condition: lamps designed for traffic on one side of the road only

text: With the traffic-change measures applied and the adjustment unchanged, a passing-beam designed for right-hand traffic and adapted to left-hand traffic shall provide at least 2.50∙10^3 cd at 0.86°D - 1.72°L.
condition: passing-beam designed for right-hand traffic adapted to left-hand traffic

text: With the traffic-change measures applied and the adjustment unchanged, a passing-beam designed for right-hand traffic and adapted to left-hand traffic shall provide not more than 8.80∙10^2 cd at 0.57°U - 3.43°R.
condition: passing-beam designed for right-hand traffic adapted to left-hand traffic

text: With the traffic-change measures applied and the adjustment unchanged, a passing-beam designed for left-hand traffic and adapted to right-hand traffic shall provide at least 2.50∙10^3 cd at 0.86°D - 1.72°R.
condition: passing-beam designed for left-hand traffic adapted to right-hand traffic

text: With the traffic-change measures applied and the adjustment unchanged, a passing-beam designed for left-hand traffic and adapted to right-hand traffic shall provide not more than 8.80∙10^2 cd at 0.57°U - 3.43°L.
condition: passing-beam designed for left-hand traffic adapted to right-hand traffic

text: The device (lamp) shall be so made that, if a light source and/or a light source module has failed, a signal indicating the failure is provided.
condition: if required by the provisions of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86

text: A signal indicating the failure of a specific function realised with more than one element for visible radiation, wired so that failure of one does not stop all, shall be provided according to the applicant's selection of one or more options: (a) one or more elements stop emitting light; (b) resulting luminous intensity in any photometric requirement is less than 80% of the minimum required; (c) resulting luminous flux has changed by more than 5%; (d) more than 5% of the elements stop emitting light (applied to the sum and to each light source separately); (e) if fitted, one or more UN approved light source(s) stops emitting light.
condition: specific function realised with more than one element for visible radiation wired so that a failure of any one does not cause all to stop emitting light

text: The component(s) to which a replaceable light source is assembled shall be so made that the light source fits easily and, even in darkness, can be fitted in no position but the correct one.

A lamp with replaceable light sources shall be considered acceptable if it meets the requirements of paragraph 5 with at least one standard (étalon) light source, which may be submitted with the lamp.
condition: lamps with replaceable light sources

text: The colour of the light emitted shall be white for all lamps.
For front fog lamps the colour of the light emitted may be selective yellow if requested by the applicant.
condition: if requested by the applicant

text: In the case of headlamps or AFS with adjustable reflector, the requirements of paragraphs 5.1. to 5.4. shall be met for each mounting position indicated according to paragraph 3.1.2.2.
condition: if the headlamp or AFS is equipped with an adjustable reflector

text: For verification of headlamps or AFS with adjustable reflector, each applied mounting position shall be realized on the test goniometer with respect to a line joining the centre of the light source and point HV on an aiming screen, and the adjustable reflector/system or part(s) thereof shall then be moved into such a position that the light pattern on the screen corresponds to the relevant aiming prescriptions.
condition: if the headlamp or AFS is equipped with an adjustable reflector

text: With the adjustable reflector/system or part(s) thereof initially fixed according to paragraph 4.17.1., the device or part(s) thereof must meet the relevant photometric requirements of paragraphs 5.1. to 5.4.
condition: if the headlamp or AFS is equipped with an adjustable reflector

text: Additional tests shall be made after the adjustable reflector/system or part(s) thereof has been moved vertically ±2°, or at least into the maximum position if less than 2°, from its initial position by means of the adjusting device, and after re-aiming the headlamp/system or part(s) thereof as a whole (e.g. by means of the goniometer) in the corresponding opposite direction.
condition: if the headlamp or AFS is equipped with an adjustable reflector

text: In the additional adjustable-reflector tests, the passing-beam light output of a headlamp at points B50L and 75R (B50R and 75L, respectively) shall lie within the required limits.
condition: if the headlamp is equipped with an adjustable reflector

text: In the additional adjustable-reflector tests, the passing-beam light output of an AFS at points B50L and 75R, or 50R if applicable, shall lie within the required limits.
condition: if the AFS is equipped with an adjustable reflector

text: In the additional adjustable-reflector tests, the passing-beam light output of class AS, BS, CS and DS headlamps at points HV and 0.86D-V shall lie within the required limits.
condition: if the headlamp of class AS, BS, CS or DS is equipped with an adjustable reflector

text: In the additional adjustable-reflector tests, the driving-beam light output at Imax and at point HV (percentage of Imax) shall lie within the required limits.
condition: if the headlamp or AFS is equipped with an adjustable reflector

text: A matched pair is allowed only for passing-beams of class C, V, AS, BS, CS or DS, driving-beams of class A, B, BS, CS, DS or ADB, and front fog lamps.

Where the applicant requests the test to verify the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, the maximum luminous intensity of the road illumination device in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction shall be not more than 2.5∙10-1 cd; the test may take into account the influence of the vehicle body.
condition: if the applicant requests this additional test

text: The headlamp providing a driving-beam of Class A, B, RA, ADB, BS, CS or DS shall be aimed according to Annex 5, paragraph 3.1., including the allowed specific tolerances of paragraph 4.
For devices where more than one light source is used to provide the driving-beam, these light sources shall be operated simultaneously to determine the maximum value of the luminous intensity (Imax).
condition: if more than one light source is used to provide the driving-beam

text: If a part of the driving-beam produced by one of the light sources is used exclusively for short time 'flash to pass' signals as declared by the applicant, this shall be indicated in the relevant drawing and a remark shall be made in the communication form.
condition: if a part of the driving-beam is used exclusively for flash to pass

text: For the coordinates of any driving-beam measuring point/line/zone a 0.25° tolerance is allowed independently at each test point for photometry unless indicated otherwise.
The luminous intensity distribution of the driving-beam, referring to Figures A4-II, A4-III or A4-IV, shall meet the requirements of Table 5.

At element 2U-V (2°U, 0°) the driving-beam shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 1.00∙103 cd for Class A, 1.70∙103 cd for Class B, 1.00∙103 cd for Class CS (secondary) and 1.70∙103 cd for Class DS (secondary).
condition: Class A, B, CS or DS

text: At element H-12L (0°, 12°L) the driving-beam shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 6.00∙102 cd for Class A and 1.50∙103 cd for Class B.
condition: Class A or B

text: At element H-9L (0°, 9°L) the driving-beam shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 2.00∙103 cd for Class A and 3.40∙103 cd for Class B.
condition: Class A or B

text: At element H-6L (0°, 6°L) the driving-beam shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 3.40∙103 cd for Class A, 5.00∙103 cd for Class B, 2.50∙103 cd for Class BS, 3.40∙103 cd for Class CS and 5.00∙103 cd for Class DS.
condition: Class A, B, BS, CS or DS

text: At element H-3L (0°, 3°L) the driving-beam shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 1.20∙104 cd for Class A, 1.75∙104 cd for Class B, 9.00∙103 cd for Class BS, 1.20∙104 cd for Class CS and 1.75∙104 cd for Class DS.
condition: Class A, B, BS, CS or DS

text: At element H-V (0°, 0°) the driving-beam shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 0.8×Imax for Classes A, B and RA, 1.60∙104 cd for Class BS, 2.00∙104 cd for Class CS and 3.00∙104 cd for Class DS.
In case of a matched pair, the contribution of each driving-beam lamp at the H-V point shall not be less than 40 per cent of the relevant beam class minimum Imax required.
condition: in case of a matched pair

text: At element H-3R (0°, 3°R) the driving-beam shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 1.20∙104 cd for Class A, 1.75∙104 cd for Class B, 9.00∙103 cd for Class BS, 1.20∙104 cd for Class CS and 1.75∙104 cd for Class DS.
condition: Class A, B, BS, CS or DS

text: At element H-6R (0°, 6°R) the driving-beam shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 3.40∙103 cd for Class A, 5.00∙103 cd for Class B, 2.50∙103 cd for Class BS, 3.40∙103 cd for Class CS and 5.00∙103 cd for Class DS.
condition: Class A, B, BS, CS or DS

text: At element H-9R (0°, 9°R) the driving-beam shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 2.00∙103 cd for Class A and 3.40∙103 cd for Class B.
condition: Class A or B

text: At element H-12R (0°, 12°R) the driving-beam shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 6.00∙102 cd for Class A and 1.50∙103 cd for Class B.
condition: Class A or B

text: The maximum luminous intensity Imax of the driving-beam shall be at least 2.70∙104 cd for Class A, 4.00∙104 cd for Class B, 1.00∙104 cd for Class RA (auxiliary), 2.00∙104 cd for Class BS, 2.70∙104 cd for Class CS and 4.00∙104 cd for Class DS.
Except for classes BS, CS and DS, the point of intersection (HV) of lines H-H and V-V shall be situated within the isocandela 80 per cent of the maximum luminous intensity (Imax) of the driving-beam.
condition: except for classes BS, CS and DS

text: The maximum value (Imax) of the driving-beam shall not exceed 2.15∙105 cd in any direction.

The reference mark (I′M) of the maximum luminous intensity of the driving-beam shall be obtained by the ratio I′M = Imax /4,300 and rounded off to the value 2.5 - 5 - 7.5 - 10 - 12.5 - 17.5 - 20 - 25 - 27.5 - 30 - 37.5 - 40 - 45 - 50.
The headlamp providing a passing-beam of Class C or V shall be aimed according to Annex 5, paragraph 3.2., including the allowed specific tolerances of paragraph 4.

If vertical adjustment of the Class C or V passing-beam headlamp cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position within the allowed tolerances, the instrumental method of Annex 6, paragraph 2. shall be applied to test compliance with the required minimum quality of the asymmetric cut-off line and to perform the beam vertical adjustment.
condition: if vertical adjustment cannot be performed repeatedly within the allowed tolerances

text: When so aimed, a Class C or V headlamp for which approval is sought solely for provision of a passing-beam shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.2.2.
condition: if approval is sought solely for a passing-beam

text: When so aimed, a Class C or V headlamp intended to provide both a passing-beam and a driving-beam shall comply with the requirements of paragraphs 5.2.2. and 5.1.
condition: if the headlamp provides both a passing-beam and a driving-beam

text: The Class C or V passing-beam shall meet the luminous intensities at the test points referred to in Table 6 and in Figure A4-V (indicated for right-hand traffic).
In Zone III (bounded by 1°U/8°L, 4°U/8°L, 4°U/8°R, 2°U/8°R, 1.5°U/6°R, 1.5°U/1.5°R, 0°/0°, 0°/4°L) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall not exceed 6.25∙102 cd for Class C and Class V.

The sum S50+S50LL+S50RR (4°U at 8°L, 0°, 8°R) of the Class C passing-beam shall be at least 1.90∙102 cd; one pair of position lamps incorporated with or intended to be installed together with the headlamp may be activated according to the indications of the applicant.
condition: Class C

text: The sum S100+S100LL+S100RR (2°U at 4°L, 0°, 4°R) of the Class C passing-beam shall be at least 3.75∙102 cd; one pair of position lamps incorporated with or intended to be installed together with the headlamp may be activated according to the indications of the applicant.
condition: Class C

text: At point BR (1°U, 2.5°R) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall not exceed 1.75∙103 cd for Class C and Class V.
On segment BLL (0.57°U, 8°L to 20°L) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall not exceed 6.25∙102 cd for Class C and Class V.
At point B50L (0.57°U, 3.43°L) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall not exceed 3.50∙102 cd for Class C and Class V.
At point P (0°, 7°L) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall be at least 6.3∙101 cd for Class C and Class V.
At point 75R (0.57°D, 1.15°R) the Class C passing-beam luminous intensity shall be at least 1.21∙104 cd.
condition: Class C

text: At point 50L (0.86°D, 3.43°L) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall be at least 5.00∙103 cd for Class C and at least 3.55∙103 cd for Class V, and shall not exceed 3.70∙104 cd for both classes.
At point 50V (0.86°D, 0°) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall be at least 5.10∙103 cd for Class C and Class V.
In case of a matched pair, the contribution of each passing-beam lamp at points 50L and 50V shall not be less than 50% of the required minimum value.
condition: in case of a matched pair

text: At point 50R (0.86°D, 1.72°R) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall be at least 1.01∙104 cd for Class C and at least 5.10∙103 cd for Class V.
On segment 50 (0.86°D, 6.84°L to 6.84°R) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall be at least 2.54∙103 cd for Class C and at least 1.80∙103 cd for Class V.
On segment 40LL (1.07°D, 14°L to 9°L) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall be at least 8.50∙102 cd for Class C and at least 6.00∙102 cd for Class V.
At point 40L (1.07°D, 9°L) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall be at least 2.80∙103 cd for Class C and at least 1.95∙103 cd for Class V.
At point 40R (1.07°D, 9°R) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall be at least 2.80∙103 cd for Class C and at least 1.95∙103 cd for Class V.
On segment 40RR (1.07°D, 9°R to 14°R) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall be at least 8.50∙102 cd for Class C and at least 6.00∙102 cd for Class V.
At point 25V (1.72°D, 0°) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall be at least 2.50∙103 cd for Class C and at least 1.75∙103 cd for Class V.
On segment 25L (1.72°D, 16°L to 9°L) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall be at least 1.18∙103 cd for Class C and at least 8.25∙102 cd for Class V.
On segment 25 (1.72°D, 9°L to 9°R) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall be at least 1.70∙103 cd for Class C and at least 1.20∙103 cd for Class V.
On segment 25R (1.72°D, 9°R to 16°R) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall be at least 1.18∙103 cd for Class C and at least 8.25∙102 cd for Class V.
On segment 15 (2.86°D, 20°L to 20°R) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall be at least 4.25∙102 cd for Class C and at least 3.00∙102 cd for Class V.
On segment 10 (4°D, 4.5°L to 2°R) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall be at least 5.00∙102 cd for Class C and at least 3.50∙102 cd for Class V.

On segment 10 and below (4°D, 4.5°L to 2°R) the passing-beam luminous intensity shall not exceed 0.8 x the actual measured value at 50R for Class C and 0.8 x the actual measured value at 25V for Class V.
The maximum luminous intensity Imax of the Class V passing-beam shall not exceed 4.41∙104 cd.
